text:
i really love the fluidity and style of how they keep the composition of their blockings and i genuinely cant get enough of watching them perform the output they have worked hard to create.

the musicality of their choreography is always such a joy to see that i have to rewatch multiple times just to see all the details that makes it make sense to eyes, it’s fascinating how choreographies like this just feel so right to look at because  they fill the spaces between them differently every new blocking while hitting the details in the music srrghrhrgrhr i love dance its the only passion that makes my eyes heat up a certain way and the clear product of skill and creativity is just awesome to see i cant word my appreciation for how consistently they cook shit just right. im rarely satisfied by anything and im not really a fan of the kpop scene but cortis genuinely impresses me and i cant wait to keep seeing their work and hopefully they never give up their passion to create and start a movement of authenticity.

 i noticed that their arm movements are always so loose and its like a signature style consistent in their choreographies and fitting to their brand and its groovy as hell however, whenever i watch a performance of theirs thats on stage i cant help but feel like because theres barely any textures in their upper body movements so the feeling of them hitting the beats is barely projecting and reaching me. its like they’re only grooving with their arm movements from a farther perspective instead of fully owning the space they take up when hitting the music. its missing a degree of sharpness so it ends up lacking clarity ? (i wish i could explain it better) their choreographies are overall great absolutely. i just hope they continue to hone their craft so that they shine brighter than they already do. 

swag will always work but you must not rely on swag type shift
